select sc.create_time, p.title, p.demand_id, p.procure_phone, p.procure_real_name, p.procure_img, p.browse_count, p.count_money
,(st_distance (point (p.receive_lng, p.receive_lat),point(#{lng},#{lat}) ) *111195) as distance
from sc_follow sc, tb_user u, procure_demand p where u.user_id = sc.user_id and sc.demand_id = p.demand_id and sc.user_id = #{userId} order by sc.create_time desc
